snippet.title: Theos: Cities of Myth | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Theos: Cities of Myth now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3002130/Theos_Cities_Of_Myth/

From the creators of Pharaoh: A New Era comes Theos: Cities of Myth, a modern tribute to the golden age of city-builders.

Travel to a reimagined Ancient Greece, where history and myth walk hand in hand. 
As the founder of a new Polis, your task is to build a thriving metropolis that satisfies both the needs of your people and the divine whims of the Olympians.

For more Theos: Cities of Myth's updates, join us on social media:

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/gaming/dotemu
